fields.statement: A run step's stall detection counts the live children of its open spawns (run.State.Spawns of the current step not yet ended) as the step's sessions, so an idle child with no done mark is nudged at the first limit and the step is stopped and resumed with --retry at the second, charged to the run's watchdog budget; a session waiting on an open spawn of its own is neither nudged nor counted stalled by its own silence, since its progress is its child's; the stop closes the panes of the step's children and of the waiting parent; the retried step's fresh conductor carries on from the journal as a part-way conduct does
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's plan of an autonomous run, derived from the milestone brief's point 2: nudge, then retry the step, for every workflow's agent steps

fields.statement: The watchdog's stall recovery states its reason on the run: each retry and each give-up names the stalled session, its role (a spawned child's role and parent, or the step's own session) and the time it last reported, in the run's journal as a warning entry that rhiza run status shows, in the charged attempt's action, and in the hold's detail and inbox item once the budget is spent; the give-up stays the existing hold and inbox item rather than a new failed state, as failed-run retry belongs to the m40-retry change set
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's plan of an autonomous run, from the intent's 'failed with a reason'

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogStalled|TestDaemonNudgeStalled|TestStepSessions' passes, including a new test that replays the 2026-11-16 case: a conduct run whose conductor session spawned a fixer (a spawn entry, no spawn-ended), the fixer's record autonomous, idle by its hook, with no done mark and its last report past the agent nudge limit; watchdogStalled nudges the fixer's session (not the conductor's) at the first limit, and past the second limit stops the run with both sessions' panes closed and resumes it with --retry, the run's budget charged once; daemonNudgeStalled sends the nudge to the fixer only. (failure case) a fixer that said done, or whose spawn has a spawn-ended entry, is neither nudged nor counted; a conductor waiting on a fixer whose last report is recent is not nudged and its run is not stopped, however old the conductor's own report
fields.files: internal/api/run.go (stepSessions and its callers' doc comments), internal/api/daemon_watchdog.go (watchdogProgress, watchdogStalled, the stop dep), internal/api/daemon_watchdog_test.go, internal/api/daemon_nudge_test.go, internal/api/run_test.go
fields.must_not: Change session.Stalled or session.Stallable, the watchdog policy keys or their defaults, rhiza run spawn's own behaviour, or any --json shape; read process trees (the runaway change set's); nudge or stop sessions of owner-attended runs beyond what the existing autonomousOnly policy allows
fields.statement: The watchdog's stalled-step pass and the daemon's session nudge cover the children a session spawns with rhiza run spawn: an idle child with no done mark is nudged, then its step stopped and retried, and the parent waiting on it is never nudged for its own silence

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogStalled' passes, including a new test where a stalled spawned fixer's retry appends one warning entry to the run's journal whose detail names the fixer's session ID, the role fixer, its parent session and its last report time, and the charged attempt's action names the same session; and where, with the retry budget spent, the hold's detail and its inbox item name that session and role. (failure case) a step that is only nudged, or that moved since, journals no warning; a stalled step's own session (no spawn) is named as the step's session with no parent
fields.files: internal/api/daemon_watchdog.go (watchdogStalled, watchdogDeps, daemonWatchdog wiring, watchdogHoldItems), internal/api/daemon_watchdog_test.go
fields.must_not: Fail the run or add a run state or journal entry type (the existing warning entry carries the reason); change the retry budget or limits; change the bug request filing beyond naming the session in its evidence
fields.statement: Every stall retry and give-up of the watchdog names its reason on the run: the stalled session, its role or spawn parent, and when it last reported, as a warning in the run's journal, in the charged attempt and in the hold's detail
